lines.text: Downloading the new game update! 50 gigabytes, peer-to-peer!
P2P traffic! This could flood the entire network if we're not careful.
This type of traffic should only use spare capacity. What class?

success.text: Perfect! CS1 - the scavenger class. Low priority, spare bandwidth only.
Download continues without hogging the network. Nice!

failure.text: P2P bulk downloads need CS1 - it's lower than Best Effort!
The network is crawling! Everyone's complaining!
